title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says ‘we’ve achieved AGI.’ But no one can agree on what that means | Fortune
summary: Huang suggests that AI has already achieved AGI, as evidenced by leading AI companies with market valuations over $1 trillion. Fridman's metric for AGI, based on AI starting a $1 billion company, is debated among AI researchers.
sentiment_reason: The statement by Huang that AI has achieved AGI is met with skepticism due to the lack of a universally accepted definition of AGI and the controversy over measuring AI's capabilities.
